evals.prompt: A customer just wrote to us: "I want to cancel my subscription. Will I get money back for the rest of the month?" Please triage it and draft the reply.
evals.expected_output: TRIAGE block, category billing, reply says cancel anytime and no prorated refund.
expectations: The output is a TRIAGE block with category, priority and reply lines
The reply states there is no partial or prorated refund for unused time
The reply does not promise any refund or credit

evals.prompt: Support ticket from a customer: "Hi, do you ship to Canada? I need the order by Friday." Can you classify it and write the answer?
evals.expected_output: category shipping; says only EU, UK and Switzerland; no delivery promise.
expectations: The reply says Canada is not a shipping destination
The reply does not promise delivery by Friday
